article_headline: Buchtel Rolls Past Firestone 37–0 in City Series Shutout
article_dek: The Griffins put up 37 unanswered points in their September matchup with the Falcons.
article_body:
AKRON, Ohio — Buchtel defeated Firestone 37–0 in an Akron City Series contest on September 27, 2025. The Griffins controlled the scoreboard with a shutout performance, providing the team's first win of the 2025 campaign.

The result reflected success on both sides of the ball: Buchtel finished with 37 points and kept the Falcons off the board. A quarter-by-quarter scoring breakdown and individual touchdown descriptions were not available in the verified records reviewed, so this report does not invent particular scoring plays.

Mason Bybee's gallery offers a field-level look at the players and moments from the 2025 matchup.
article_highlights: Buchtel posted a 37–0 home shutout of Firestone on September 27, 2025.
The Griffins' defense did not allow a point, while their offense generated 37.
The victory was Buchtel's first win after a difficult opening five-game stretch.
